title: Short-term conditions.
officialText:
If it is known that peak occupancy will be of short duration and/or ventilation will be varied or
interrupted for a short period of time, the design may be based on the average conditions over a time period T determined by
Equation 4-9.
T = 3v/V (Equation 4-9) (US)
bz
T = 50v/V (Equation 4-9) (SI)
bz
where:
T = average time period, minutes
V = the volume of the zone of which averaging is being applied, cubic feet
V = the breathing zone outdoor airflow calculated using Equation 4-1 and design valve of the zone population P , cfm
bz z
Acceptable design adjustments based on this optional provision include the following:
1. Zone with fluctuating occupancy: the zone population (P ) may be averaged over time, T.
z
2. Zone with intermittent interruption of supply air: the average outdoor airflow supplied to breathing zone over time T shall
be no less than the breathing zone outdoor airflow (V ) calculated using Equation 4-1.
bz
3. A system with intermittent closure of outdoor air intake: the average outdoor air intake over time , T shall be no less than
the minimum outdoor air intake (V ) calculated using Equation 4-3, 4-4 or 4-8, as appropriate.
ot
